notes:
Summary: Large North American insurance platform (core policy + claims). Heavy PII and regulated flows; explicit requirement: customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM-backed key material. Interest in Redwood Private (VPC) deployment with strict audit logging forwarded to customer SIEM. Primary drivers: data residency controls, key ownership, and cryptographic attestation for regulators.

KMS/HSM specifics discussed:
- AWS KMS: want CMKs in customer account, key policy restrictions, CloudHSM-backed keys with FIPS 140-2 requirement. Need demonstration of envelope encryption and key-wrap flow across Redwood runtime.
- Azure: Azure Key Vault + HSM (Managed HSM) for EU-region keys; confirm RBAC mapping for service principal and managed identity options.
- GCP: KMS with external key manager (EKM) compatibility; ask about latency impact for synchronous token encryption calls.
- BYOK process: key import lifecycle, rotation cadence, revocation scenario (instant cutover), and proof that Redwood cannot export plaintext key material.

Operational & compliance notes:
- Audit logging: all key operations and per-request token events must be forwarded to Splunk (customer SIEM) and retained 13 months. Compliance team requires sample logs and a retention policy draft.
- Data residency: model inference logs for EU customers must not leave eu-central-1; request confirmation of regional routing and key residency enforcement.
- KMS integration testing: want a dry-run POC where we bring CMK (test key) and validate encrypt/decrypt latency (p95) under 100ms for inline calls; if exceeded, prefer async envelope with local DEK cache.

Quotes / direct paraphrase:
- "We own the keys or nothing ships to production." — Head of InfoSec (G. Alvarez).
- "Latency target for chat/underwriting synapse flow is p95 < 250ms end-to-end; embeddings batch can be relaxed." — Lead ML Engineer (N. Patel).

Tech preferences & model routing:
- Prefer quantized Llama-3 class models for latency/cost. Will evaluate Redwood-verified model variants.
- Want automatic fallback: if private capacity is constrained, route to Dedicated in same region with enforced key-wrapping and no plaintext export. Need proof-of-concept for fallback with preserved key control.

Commercial / procurement:
- Procurement team prepping enterprise PO; legal wants explicit KMS BYOK SOW + crypto annex. Estimated ARR window: 500k-2M depending on committed capacity.

Recommended Redwood asks/action items:
- Share BYOK runbook and HSM attestation template (we already provided preliminary doc but they want vendor-signed copy).
- Schedule 3-hour KMS integration lab with Marcus + infra team + Sentinel security (target week of 2025-12-22).
- Provide example audit log payloads and Splunk ingestion example (ELK/SIEM mapping).
- Provide architecture diagram showing envelope encryption, DEK caching, and fallback routing for Dedicated endpoints.
